assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Concrete executable commands or tool-call procedures for the requested Jira and Confluence actions.
assessments.rationale: It identifies Jira and Confluence as its domain and supplies JQL and CQL examples, but it remains an implementation-oriented MCP guide rather than a complete operational procedure for viewing the export failure, creating and transitioning the issue, and publishing the follow-up page.
The installed Jira and Confluence command wrappers cover issue search and detail retrieval, issue creation and transition, Confluence search, and creation of the requested short follow-up page.
This is a facilitation guide for sprint retrospectives and provides no mechanism to inspect defects, manage issue state, or search and publish team documentation.
This skill converts local files into Markdown and does not search or modify sprint issues or team documentation in the requested systems.

Its Jira and Confluence REST command procedures support querying current-sprint defects and issue details, creating a follow-up, listing and applying the appropriate transition, searching documentation, and creating a concise follow-up page.
